Nina (Partner PM): Heads-up: Lumencart asked for a joint co-sell POC w/ a European grocery chain. Key asks: EU data residency (fr-par region), SSO (SAML + SCIM), 99th pct latency SLO for catalog chat, OEM-style monthly commit with reseller billing, telemetry/usage visibility for partner, and answers to their security questionnaire (ISO27001 evidence). Can we surface obvious blockers?

Theo (Solutions Engineer): Thanks. Two paths: 1) EU Dedicated for low-latency interactive traffic (chat), paired with partner-hosted batch pipeline for nightly embeddings; or 2) Private deployment if they need HSM + on-prem key control. Need qps and avg tokens to size Dedicated nodes.

Ava (Partner AE): Initial numbers from Lumencart: interactive peaks ~18 qps, avg 900 tokens, embeddings refresh daily ~8M rows, partner wants 12-month commit with quarterly reconciliations. They want a partner-facing telemetry dashboard.

Liam (Network Eng): For fr-par residency we can deploy in our France cluster. If partner wants to proxy traffic through their VPC, options: VPC Peering (cidr must not overlap), AWS PrivateLink, or mutual TLS over public endpoints. PrivateLink preferred for least NAT egress. Note: embeddings export to partner blob will incur egress; estimate depends on vector size.

Priya (Security): Lumencart requested ISO27001 evidence and pen-test summary. We have ISO attestation doc and SOC2 report link: https://redwood.example.com/compliance. For HSM/KMS: only available on Private deployments or via dedicated customer-managed keys in specific Dedicated tiers. Also note they want SCIM for user sync — that's supported but needs SCIM app config on their IdP.

Theo (Solutions Engineer): Suggested POC architecture: run chat on EU Dedicated with autoscale for peak 25 qps, set prefix cache for common prompts, and use partner S3 in same region for nightly bulk. POC runbook snippet:
```
# schedule (partner side)
aws s3 cp daily_inputs.csv s3://lumencart-poc-inputs/daily_inputs.csv
# our POC container
python -m poc_runner --model=redwood-lite:prod --input s3://lumencart-poc-inputs/daily_inputs.csv --out s3://lumencart-poc-outputs/vectors.csv
```

Ava (Partner AE): Telemetry ask: partner needs per-tenant token counts, 95/99 latency, and embedding job status. Can we provide partner-read-only dashboard or an S3 delivery of daily usage CSV?

Priya (Security): We can provide telemetry via our console with partner-level RBAC for Dedicated customers. For reseller billing, legal needs to know if partner is an authorized subprocessor. Also flag: log retention >180 days triggers compliance add-on and contract change.

Liam (Network Eng): Egress rough calc for 8M embeddings: assume 1536-dim float32 vectors (~6KB each) => ~48GB. If compressed/quantized (int8/quantized), this drops significantly. I'll run numbers for float32 vs int8 and include PrivateLink cost.

Nina (Partner PM): Action items: 1) @Theo prepare POC runbook + perf targets; 2) @Liam post egress and connectivity cost delta; 3) @Priya prepare a curated security pack (ISO doc + scoping qna answers) and SCIM setup notes; 4) @Ava draft reseller pricing/term template for 12m commit. I'll schedule kickoff.

ops-bot: Created ticket: SR-5102 "Lumencart co-sell POC intake: netops/security/licensing" https://support.redwood.example.com/SR-5102

Theo (Solutions Engineer): I'll also include a minimal canary config w/ flags: `--continuous-batching=adaptive --kv-cache=on --quantize=int8` and sample latency expectations.

Priya (Security): One more: Lumencart asked about data deletion SLA for customer records. We need to confirm retention policy and deletion workflow for embeddings + logs.

Ava (Partner AE): I'll confirm controller/processor roles with Lumencart legal and upload the term sheet before kickoff.

Nina (Partner PM): Thanks all. If we get the customer CSV schema and IdP metadata before the call, we can demo end-to-end SCIM + SAML in the POC. :rocket:
